verdict.rationale: Adyen documents transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations that don't meet business requirements, plus relayed authorisation for real-time approve/decline decisions within 2000 ms. Together these give an authorization-time mechanism where merchant-based restrictions could be enforced, possibly via your own server logic. However, the evidence never explicitly names MCC or merchant as rule criteria. Missing for 10: explicit MCC allowlist/blocklist rule documentation, single-merchant lock support, ops-UI configuration of merchant restrictions, independent corroboration.
